description: Source code for MediaDecoder class handling audio and video decoding using Android MediaCodec, including thread management, error handling, and buffer processing.

classes.name: MediaDecoder
classes.description: Handles media decoding for audio and video streams, manages threading, buffer queues, error reporting, and interaction with Android MediaCodec.

methods.name: MediaDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for audio or video MediaDecoder, initializes media codec bridge and pending tasks.

methods.name: ~MediaDecoder
methods.description: Destructor, cleans up threads and flushes media codec.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes error callback and schedules error reporting if needed.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Starts decoder thread if needed and enqueues input buffers for decoding.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets playback rate for video decoding.

methods.name: DecoderThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Static thread entry point for decoder thread.

methods.name: DecoderThreadFunc
methods.description: Main loop for decoding thread, processes input/output buffers.

methods.name: CollectPendingData_Locked
methods.description: Collects pending tasks and output results in thread-safe manner.

methods.name: ProcessOneInputBuffer
methods.description: Processes a single input buffer, queues it to MediaCodec, handles errors.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Handles errors from MediaCodec, with retry logic for recoverable errors.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports errors to callback, ensures single report.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecError
methods.description: Handles MediaCodec errors, logs and reports unrecoverable errors.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecInputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Callback when input buffer is available, adds to queue.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecOutputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Callback when output buffer is available, queues for processing.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecFrameRendered
methods.description: Callback when a frame is rendered, invokes frame rendered callback.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes and resets the media codec, restarts decoding.
